platform.name: microX dashboard-test
platform.description: Assessment definition for the dashboard-test host.

authorization.reference: Authorized assessment target: 192.168.1.81 mapped as dashboard-test; configured web origins plus discovered same-host HTTP/HTTPS services are active-test scope when allow_same_host_ports=true.

dashboard_session.purpose: Authorized browser-based dashboard identity. An existing cookie is tried first on the configured origin and, when allow_same_host_ports=true, on another discovered port of the same hostname/scheme because HTTP cookies are not port-scoped. Each use is validated; if the session is not usable, saved browser/OIDC state is tried next and the original username/password are reused only if the same issuer/realm requests them. No second console prompt is opened.

services.notes: Enable this service only if curl/browser confirms that dashboard-test answers on HTTP port 80.
Enable this service only if curl/browser confirms that dashboard-test answers on HTTPS port 443.
